description: The named pipelines people actually ask for — stems, session (mix → DAW project), cover, transcribe, generate, render-midi (your notes played by an instrument model), analyze-song (key/tempo/sections/chords), convert, bounce, and the compose-part guide (a part in the session's key at its tempo: analyze → you write the MIDI → place or render it) — each with its inputs, the tool calls in order, outputs, a credit/time estimate and how to VERIFY success from the response. Call with no name for the index (pick by use_when), or with a name for the full recipe. Read-only.

name.description: A recipe name or alias, e.g. "session" / "stems-to-session". Omit to list all.
